[size=6]Introduce[/size]

[size=3]This mod gives the cabin more features.[/size]

[size=6]Feature[/size]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]Visit Cabin Info[/b]. When you visit a cabin, a message related to the cabin owner is displayed in the bottom right corner of the game.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]Cabin Owner Name Tag[/b]. The name of the cabin owner is displayed on the cabin.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]Delete Farmhand[/b]. Instead of deleting the cabin, you can just delete the cabin owner's assocation to the cabin.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Arial]
